Prior review retained below:
Read all 240 questions and individually reviewed each answer against axis definitions and cited policy. Rechecked current Macron/Lecornu scope, actual 2026 measures versus the unimplemented 2027 budget, legal territorial exceptions, public ownership versus contracts and regulation, and culture/nature trait-specific explanatory fit. Tightened ordinary family reunification and national medicine coverage with direct administrative rules; replaced broad anticipation inference with official imminent-cyberattack pre-emption doctrine; revised family identity to a mixed public/shared and private/plural position. Corrected publication dates from source pages, retaining undated where exact dates were unavailable rather than inventing days. Neutral responses reflect specified conditional or competing institutional arrangements. Culture/Nature Q2 (between-country IQ causation) and Q10 (immediate moral reactions) remain unknown: social programmes, anti-racism, empathy or teaching norms do not answer those causal comparisons. Flag File page creator and public-domain terms checked; 960x640 PNG visually checked, 932 bytes, no crop. Shared credits and separate parent audit remain parent integration tasks. This is a same-agent second pass, not falsely described as an independent reviewer. No answers were tuned toward neighbours or desired scores. Final profiles validate country france reports only the two intentionally unresolved answers (two messages per answer); no metadata, source-date, reference or review errors remain. Neutral-count warnings were examined for immigration (5/16: EU versus non-EU, graduate temporary status, capacity and cultural-selection distinctions), trade (7/16: EU common rules plus sectoral protection and suspended retaliation), redistribution (5/16: retained support versus restraint, adequacy and compensated land allocation), and causation (5/16: documented interaction models). No neighbours are returned while unresolved answers prevent scoring; no completed similarity comparison is claimed. Additional parent research check, 2026-10-04, Codex: targeted official education and civic-information searches did not resolve Culture/Nature 02 or 10. General intelligence development, individual heritability, philosophical discussion prompts and teaching moral norms do not establish an incumbent institutional comparison of national IQ causes or immediate moral intuitions. No answer changed and no publication sign-off is implied. Focused continuation on 2026-10-05 by primary OpenAI Codex agent /root: Reread the October 2025 SES socialisation guide, pp.1–4. It discusses unconscious acquired dispositions and moral education, but does not compare biological predispositions and culture for immediate moral intuitions or inherited versus educational causes of national IQ averages. General socialisation is insufficient for these exact rankings. All 2 exact question-level gaps remain null/unknown. Existing supported answers, period and cutoff are preserved. This was a focused same-agent research and separate challenge pass, not a complete independent re-review or publication sign-off. Separate completion pass on 2026-10-05: checked the 2 new educated assumptions against exact question wording, agreement direction, contextual sources and prior withdrawal reasons. These are most-likely provisional estimates, not adopted national causal theories. The distinction between individual and national/racial heredity, immediate intuition and deliberate instruction, and interventions and causal predominance is retained. Assumption IDs: culture-nature-02, culture-nature-10. Reviewed neutral-heavy axis rationales: explicit mixed institutions, competing implemented rules and interaction models justify retained neutral choices; uncertainty alone was not used as the neutral rationale. Earlier whole-assessment review is preserved; this continuation does not claim a fresh independent 240-source reread or a human review. Similarity and browser checks are recorded separately after integration.
